scientific.integrity: The result is a closed-form stationary analysis of the published SOAP moment and eigenbasis update structure. All finite-dimensional singular-value formulas are derived exactly and independently replayed.
limitations: Constant-gradient stationary analysis, not global training dynamics.
The sharp condition-number formula uses a normalized two-dimensional SPD family.
A positive epsilon regularizes sufficiently small basis errors.
Update singular-value collapse alone is not claimed to imply optimization divergence.

title: Exact stale-basis singular-value collapse in SOAP
